info.title: Flashduty Open API
info.description: Public HTTP API for the Flashduty AI SRE platform — skills, MCP servers (connectors), A2A agents, and sessions. Every operation is authenticated with an `app_key` query parameter issued from the Flashduty console.

post.description: List agent sessions visible to the caller, filtered by app, surface, archive status, and team.

x-mint.content:
## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **1,000 requests/minute**; **50 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | None — any valid `app_key` can call this operation |

## Usage

- Pagination uses `p`/`limit` (max 100); `scope` defaults to `all`.
- `all` returns your personal sessions plus team sessions you can access; account admins see all team sessions, but not other users' personal sessions.
- `team_ids` narrows the visible set and never expands access.
- `is_running` reflects the live run-set; `has_unread` is computed per calling user.

post.description: Fetch one session plus a backward-paged window of its most recent events.

## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **1,000 requests/minute**; **50 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | None — any valid `app_key` can call this operation |

## Usage

- Personal sessions are readable only by their creator; team sessions can be read by same-account callers with the `session_id`.
- Page older history with `search_after_ctx` from the previous response.
- `limit` (or legacy `num_recent_events`) caps the event page; default 100, max 1000.

post.description: Stream a session's full event transcript as newline-delimited JSON.

x-mint.content:
## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **1,000 requests/minute**; **50 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | None — any valid `app_key` can call this operation |

## Usage

- Personal sessions are exportable only by their creator; team sessions can be exported by same-account callers with the `session_id`.
- The response is `application/x-ndjson` — parse line-by-line and write to a file; do not buffer the whole body in memory.
- The first line is always a `session_meta` envelope; `include_subagents=true` inlines each child session's stream after its dispatch line.

200.description: Streaming NDJSON (application/x-ndjson). One JSON object per line, terminated by a newline. The first line is always a `session_meta` envelope; subsequent lines are session events.

schema.description: Newline-delimited JSON stream. Parse line-by-line; do not buffer the whole body.

post.description: Create an Automation rule with schedule, HTTP POST, and On-call incident triggers.

x-mint.content:
## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **1,000 requests/minute**; **50 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | Valid `app_key`; management operations require the caller to manage the target rule |

## Usage

- A caller may create personal rules and rules for any team in the current account; `team_id` is immutable after creation.
- Rule lists include your personal rules plus accessible team rules; account admins see all team rules, but not other users' personal rules.
- Get, update, delete, and run history access require manage rights: the personal rule owner; for team rules, an account admin or a member of the rule's team.
- `http_post_token` is returned only when creating or rotating the token. Save it immediately.
- To trigger from On-call incidents, send `oncall_incident_trigger_enabled`, `oncall_incident_channel_ids`, and `oncall_incident_severities`; matching events run with `trigger_kind=oncall_incident`.

AppKeyAuth.name: app_key
AppKeyAuth.description: App key issued from the Flashduty console. Required on every public API call. Keep it secret — it grants the same access as the owning account.

AutomationTriggerBearerAuth.description: Bearer token generated for one Automation HTTP POST trigger. This is not an app_key.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request — usually a missing or malformed parameter.

error.message: The specified parameter skill_id is not valid.

Forbidden.description: The app_key is valid but lacks permission for this operation.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit hit. Either the global API limit or a per-account limit.

ServerError.description: Unexpected server-side error. Include the request_id when reporting.

error.message: We encountered an internal error, and it has been reported. Please try again later.

ErrorCode.description: Flashduty error code enum. Every failed API response sets `error.code` to one of these values. The value is a stable wire string — not a localized message and not a numeric status. HTTP status is informational.

DutyError.description: Error payload inside the response envelope. Present only on non-2xx responses.

message.description: Human-readable error message, localized by the caller's Accept-Language. May contain field names, IDs, or other context from the failing request.

ResponseEnvelope.description: Standard response envelope used by every Flashduty public API. On success `data` contains the endpoint-specific payload and `error` is absent. On failure `error` is present and `data` is absent. `request_id` is always present and is also mirrored in the `Flashcat-Request-Id` response header.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this request. Mirrored in the Flashcat-Request-Id header. Include it when reporting issues.

data.description: Endpoint-specific payload. See each operation's 200 response schema.

ErrorResponse.description: Response envelope for errors. `error` is required; `data` is absent.

SessionGetRequest.description: Fetch one session plus a backward-paged window of its most recent events.

num_recent_events.description: Legacy page size: number of most-recent events to return. Superseded by `limit` when both are set; 0 uses the server default (100).

limit.description: Page size for events; takes precedence over `num_recent_events`. 0 uses the server default (100).

search_after_ctx.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response; pass it back to fetch the next older page.

SessionListRequest.description: Filters for listing agent sessions. `all` visibility means the caller's own personal sessions plus accessible team sessions; account admins do not see other users' personal sessions.

app_name.description: Agent app whose sessions to list.

asc.description: Ascending order when true; applies only when `orderby` is set.

include_subagent_sessions.description: Include subagent-dispatched sessions in the list.

scope.description: Visibility scope: `all` (own personal + accessible team sessions), `personal`, or `team`; default `all`.

team_ids.description: Optional explicit team filter; intersects with `scope` and never expands access.

entry_kinds.description: Restrict to sessions produced by these surfaces; empty returns every kind.

status.description: Archive bucket: active (default) returns un-archived, archived returns archived, all returns both.

SessionExportRequest.description: Export the full event transcript of one session as a streaming NDJSON body.

include_subagents.description: When true, each subagent_dispatch line is followed by the child session's full event stream, bracketed by its own session_meta. Defaults to false.

parent_session_id.description: Parent session id for subagent (child) sessions; empty otherwise.

session_name.description: Session title; may be empty for untitled sessions.

app_name.description: Agent app that owns the session.

team_id.description: Owning team id; 0 means no team is bound. Immutable after create.

team_name.description: Resolved team name; empty for unbound rows or deleted teams.

is_mine.description: True when the caller created this session.

can_manage.description: True when the caller may rename/archive/delete the session; personal sessions are creator-only, team sessions allow the creator, account admin, or team member.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the session was created.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last session update.

template_staging_round_id.description: Current save→validate round id (template-assistant only); empty otherwise.

state.description: Raw session-state bag (session-scoped keys). Omitted when empty.

current_context_tokens.description: Size in tokens of the LLM context window as of the most recent turn. 0 means no turn has completed.

context_window.description: The bound model's max context size in tokens. 0 means unknown.

archived_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when archived; 0 means not archived.

pinned_at.description: Caller's per-user pin timestamp in milliseconds; 0 means not pinned.

last_event_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the most recent assistant-side event.

is_running.description: True when an agent turn is currently in flight for this session.

has_unread.description: True when there is assistant output the caller has not yet viewed.

SessionGetResponse.description: A session plus a backward-paged window of its events.

has_more_older.description: True when older events remain beyond this page.

search_after_ctx.description: Opaque keyset cursor; pass back as search_after_ctx to fetch the next older page. Omitted when has_more_older is false.

total.description: Total number of sessions matching the filter (ignoring pagination).

EventItem.description: One persisted session event. content/actions/usage_metadata carry the raw ADK envelope; treat them as opaque structured payloads.

invocation_id.description: ADK invocation id grouping a turn.

author.description: Event author (e.g. user, the agent name).

branch.description: ADK branch path for nested agents.

actions.description: ADK actions envelope (state deltas, transfers, escalation).

partial.description: True for a streaming partial chunk.

turn_complete.description: True on the terminal event of a turn.

error_code.description: Error code when the event represents a failure.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the event was written.

SessionTokenUsage.description: Cumulative session-level token rollup across all turns. The account-billing source of truth.

input_tokens.description: Total prompt (input) tokens, including the cached portion.

cached_tokens.description: Portion of input_tokens served from the prompt cache.

EnvironmentBinding.description: The runner or cloud sandbox the session is bound to. Null until the first message.

ContextResolvedItem.description: Snapshot of the three-tier knowledge-pack resolution for this session.

incident_id.description: Bound incident id, when war-room originated.

resolved_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the packs were resolved.

team_id.description: Scope team ID. 0 or omitted means a personal rule; >0 means a team in the account. Immutable after creation.

enabled.description: Whether the rule is enabled after creation. Omitted API value is false; Chat/CLI create sends true by default unless the user asks for disabled.

cron_expr.description: Run cadence. Supports 4 fields (`hour day month weekday`, minute defaults to 0) and 5 fields (`minute hour day month weekday`). The minute must be one fixed integer; 6-field seconds are not supported. The create API currently requires this field even for HTTP-POST-only rules; send a valid cron and set `schedule_trigger_enabled=false`.

schedule_trigger_enabled.description: Whether the schedule trigger is enabled. Defaults to true when omitted; HTTP-POST-only rules should send false.

prompt.description: Task prompt sent to the AI SRE agent on each run.

environment_kind.description: Runtime environment kind. Omit or send an empty value for automatic selection.

environment_id.description: BYOC Runner ID. Used only when `environment_kind=byoc`.

http_post_trigger_enabled.description: Whether to create and enable an HTTP POST trigger. When enabled, the response includes a one-time token.

oncall_incident_trigger_enabled.description: Whether the On-call incident trigger is enabled.

oncall_incident_channel_ids.description: On-call integration IDs to watch. Creating or enabling this trigger requires at least one valid ID.

oncall_incident_severities.description: Incident severities to watch. Supported values are Critical, Warning, and Info; creating or enabling this trigger requires at least one value.

AutomationRuleUpdateRequest.description: Update an Automation rule. Omit fields to leave them unchanged.

team_id.description: Only the current value is accepted; personal/team scope is immutable after creation.

cron_expr.description: Run cadence. Supports 4 fields (`hour day month weekday`, minute defaults to 0) and 5 fields (`minute hour day month weekday`). The minute must be one fixed integer; 6-field seconds are not supported. The create API currently requires this field even for HTTP-POST-only rules; send a valid cron and set `schedule_trigger_enabled=false`.

schedule_trigger_enabled.description: Whether the schedule trigger is enabled.

environment_kind.description: Runtime environment kind. Omit or send an empty value for automatic selection.

http_post_trigger_enabled.description: Whether the HTTP POST trigger is enabled. Sending true creates one when missing.

oncall_incident_trigger_enabled.description: Whether the On-call incident trigger is enabled.

oncall_incident_channel_ids.description: On-call integration IDs to watch. Creating or enabling this trigger requires at least one valid ID.

oncall_incident_severities.description: Incident severities to watch. Supported values are Critical, Warning, and Info; creating or enabling this trigger requires at least one value.

rotate_http_post_trigger_token.description: Whether to rotate the HTTP POST trigger token. The new token is returned only in this response.

AutomationRuleListRequest.description: List Automation rules visible to the caller. `all` includes the caller's personal rules plus accessible team rules; account admins do not see other users' personal rules in list results.

scope.description: Scope filter: `all` (own personal + accessible team rules), `personal`, or `team`; default `all`.

team_ids.description: Filter to these team IDs; this narrows results and does not expand access.

include_person.description: Compatibility field; when scope is empty and this is false, behaves like team scope.

team_id.description: Scope team ID; 0 means personal rule.

environment_kind.description: Runtime environment kind. Omit or send an empty value for automatic selection.

schedule_trigger_enabled.description: Whether the schedule trigger is enabled.

http_post_trigger_enabled.description: Whether the HTTP POST trigger is enabled.

oncall_incident_trigger_enabled.description: Whether the On-call incident trigger is enabled.

oncall_incident_channel_ids.description: On-call integration IDs to watch. Creating or enabling this trigger requires at least one valid ID.

oncall_incident_severities.description: Incident severities to watch. Supported values are Critical, Warning, and Info; creating or enabling this trigger requires at least one value.

http_post_token.description: HTTP POST trigger token. Returned only on create or token rotation; save it immediately.

can_edit.description: True when the caller can manage this rule: the personal rule owner; for team rules, an account admin or a member of the rule's team.

schedule_next_fire_at_ms.description: Next scheduled fire time, Unix milliseconds. 0 means no future scheduled fire is available.

locale.description: Template locale such as zh-CN or en-US. Omit to detect from the request locale.

completed_at.description: Completion time, Unix milliseconds. 0 means not completed.
